description.en: A composer-dock wallet pill for DeepSeek Harness: it shows the balance of the account behind DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and opens a panel with top-up and granted balances, the current peak/off-peak billing window with a live switch countdown, and per-model token prices. Read-only, zero configuration, no files written.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额胶囊：在输入框下方显示 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 对应账户的余额，点开可查看充值/赠送余额、当前峰谷计费时段与切换倒计时，以及各模型每百万 token 的价目表。只读、零配置、不落盘。
